camera_intrinsics_preset.replacement_required: Replace camera_matrix and distortion with HALCON calibration results at 4096x3000 before measurement.

notes: The camera intrinsics are nominal startup presets, not HALCON calibration output.
The zero distortion and laser plane are placeholders and must not be used for metrology.
Changing camera position, laser position, focus or optical elements invalidates the laser-plane calibration.
